# Fictional portfolio fixtures

All text is invented for this repository. No resume, upload, candidate record,
or existing application database was used. Names identify fictional personas;
email uses reserved example.com / example.org domains. Companies are Fictional
Orchard Studio and Fictional Harbor Workshop. All document metadata identifies
the fixture generator and uses a fixed date. ZIP entry dates are fixed too.

`generate.py DESTINATION` creates strong.pdf, strong.docx, review.pdf and
review.docx from the same visible source text. The checked-in files are generated from this source. The demo runner regenerates
them inside its owned directory. Repeated generation produces identical bytes.

Avery Example has the scripted strong-match outcome; Riley Sample enters human
review and can be rejected manually. These outcomes are demonstrations, not
validated predictions. Only accounts and initial jobs are seeded; applications,
interviews, evaluations, reports and messages must be created through the app.
